children: COFFEE HOLDING CO INC reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $21.69M and diluted EPS of $0.35, marking a turnaround to net income of $1.99M versus a loss in the year-ago quarter, supported by favorable inventory adjustments, tariff refunds and trading gains.
Revenue was $21.69M for 3Q 2026, down from $23.91M in the year-ago quarter (9.3% decline).
Net income was $1.99M for 3Q 2026, versus a loss of $(1.21)M in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS was $0.35 for 3Q 2026, versus $(0.21) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue trend: Net sales were slightly higher year-to-date (+$0.84M) despite a 9.3% decline in Q3 driven by price-related reductions as green coffee prices fell.
Margin and cost dynamics: Gross margin improved materially to about 25% in Q3 from 9.4% a year earlier, driven by favorable inventory valuation, tariff refunds and net trading gains.
Channel and customer momentum: Growth from legacy and new customers supported modest year-to-date sales gains while the company pursues private-label and branded expansion.
Operational actions: Continued strategic investments including prior acquisitions (such as Empire Coffee), a west-coast sales focus and scaled-back hedging to limit futures exposure.
